name: qlibr/newsflash-rss-tests
description: PHPUnit tests for the Newsflash RSS WordPress plugin.

scripts-descriptions.compat: Check the plugin against its PHP 7.4 floor. First registers the PHPCompatibility + PHPCSUtils standards via config-set (writes vendor/.../CodeSniffer.conf; --runtime-set cannot register a standard for discovery), then runs phpcs.

extra.notes: phpcompatibility/php-compatibility is on dev-develop deliberately: the last tagged release (9.3.5, 2019) predates PHP 8 and cannot detect 8.x functions/operators against a 7.4 target. composer.lock pins the exact commit for reproducible installs; do NOT bump this back to ^9.3 without restoring equivalent 8.x coverage.
